disposition_reason: The opinion's batch-to-batch table prints mercury, cadmium, arsenic, lead and other metals for five batches of the DHA-rich algal oil intended for infant and follow-on formula; all toxic-metal results are below LOQ except where noted. The Panel concluded that the safety of the NF has not been established, because the source strain was not characterized to species level (not because of metals).
disposition_locator: Table 1 (batch-to-batch analysis of the NF after addition of sunflower oil), Heavy metals (mg/kg), p. 7

study.design: EFSA NDA Panel novel-food safety opinion; applicant batch-to-batch compositional data (5 batches)
study.origin: Applicant's commercial fermentation of Schizochytrium sp. strain ATCC 20889; production site not stated
study.method: Mercury by AOAC 18th edition; Cd, As, Pb, Cu by Chp-9/ICP (AOAC), per Table 1
lod: LOQs printed in the table cells: tHg 0.01 mg/kg; Cd 0.01 mg/kg; tAs 0.01 mg/kg; Pb 0.01 mg/kg; Cu 0.01 mg/kg
study.qa: Panel states the applicant provided information on the accreditation of the laboratories; no CRM or recovery data reported in the opinion
